newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil court to rule on cellular Band B tenders.
newsitem.headline: Brazil court to rule on cellular Band B tenders.

text.p: Brazil's highest court was due to vote Thursday on the constitutionality of the government's multi-billion dollar Band B cellular telephone tenders, a spokesman said.

The spokesman said the Supreme Federal Tribunal (STF) would start ruling at 1400 local/1700 GMT on whether the government could auction off 15-year Band B concessions before Congress has approved a new general telecommunications bill.
The court ruling was expected to be closely watched by 12 international and national consortia that will bid on April 7 to run 10 potentially lucrative service areas.
Communications Minister Sergio Motta said Wednesday he expected the concessions to bring in $5.0-6.0 billion for the government coffers.
